_comment: Which fork commit pairs with this repo's state. Same pattern as wowsims.lock.json (plan decision D1). branchedFrom is the upstream commit this fork branch actually sits on -- read it as a fact about the clone, not as a restatement of wowsims.lock.json. As of 2026-09-10 both this file and data/wowsims.lock.json name ec5c5f205e61049d730e460967f8488774a7fe2a on feature/backend-reforge (ADR-0030); ticket 251 is closed with a shape-changed note, since the engine pin moving onto the branch was a fourth option that ticket never contemplated. commit is the merge commit that brought that upstream commit into feat/upgrades-tab, so branchedFrom is its merge-base with upstream. The clone at clonePath is gitignored (vendor/) and has its own .git pushing to the personal fork. pushed:false records that nothing has left this machine -- plan section 1 keeps any push behind a separate explicit ask, so flipping this flag is a deliberate act, not a side effect.
